GitHub Partner Program

# Technology Partners

## Build with GitHub

Create integrations across the GitHub platform and bring your product into the workflows developers use every day.

### Extend your product

Connect your solution to GitHub through apps, GitHub Actions, APIs, security integrations, and MCP servers.

### Reach more developers

Make your integration discoverable to GitHub's global developer community and help shared customers build, secure, and ship software.

## How to qualify

Integration paths

## Choose the integration model that fits your product and the experience you want to create.

### [GitHub Actions](https://github.com/partners/integration-resources/2021/03/19/pattern-releasing-and-maintaining-actions.html?locale=en-US)

Automate build, test, security, deployment, and operational tasks in customer repositories.

Build GitHub Actions

### [MCP](https://github.com/mcp?locale=en-US)

List your MCP server in the GitHub MCP Registry and make it available across supported GitHub experiences.

Explore MCP Registry

### [GitHub Advanced Security](https://docs.github.com/en/get-started/learning-about-github/about-github-advanced-security)

Connect your solution to code scanning, vulnerability management, security information and event management (SIEM), and security reporting workflows.

Explore Advanced Security

### [Secret scanning](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/tutorials/secret-scanning-partner-program)

Help prevent credential leaks by joining GitHub's secret scanning partner program.

Explore secret scanning

## Technology Partner benefits

Benefits

### Technology Partner benefits

[Apply now](https://github.com/partners/technology-partners/apply?locale=en-US)

### Partner events and recognition

Connect with GitHub teams and other partners through webinars, Partner Kickoff, GitHub Universe experiences, and the Partner of the Year awards.

[Explore GitHub events](https://github.com/resources/events?locale=en-US)

> **Atlassian’s partnership with GitHub boosts developer productivity** by bringing personalized context directly into their IDE through the GitHub Copilot extension.
